name: Koersplein Machine Arena Europe
principle: Each forecast is frozen at T. No machine in the blind path may access evidence, prices or revisions that became available after T.
customerOutput: No synthetic 0-100 score. Rank the strongest candidates separately for 3, 6, 12 and 24 months.

machines.name: Data Truth
machines.role: Point-in-time universe, prices, corporate actions and provenance

machines.name: Time Machine
machines.role: Blind historical forecasts using only information available at T

machines.name: Hindsight Researcher
machines.role: Study winners and losers with future outcomes visible; propose explanations only

machines.name: Independent Judge
machines.role: Falsify hindsight hypotheses on untouched purged/embargoed periods and markets

machines.name: Sector & Peer Specialist
machines.role: Compare companies within sector, industry, size and economically similar peer groups

machines.name: Market Regime Specialist
machines.role: Learn conditional behaviour across bull/bear, rates, inflation, growth, stress and liquidity regimes

machines.name: Relative Winner
machines.role: Predict which shares outperform their sector, peers and local market

machines.name: Price & Volume Pattern
machines.role: Test reproducible multi-horizon price, momentum, volatility, drawdown, breakout and volume patterns

machines.name: Fundamental Specialist
machines.role: Use only fundamentals whose publication/tradable timestamp was known at T

machines.name: Anomaly & Loser Guard
machines.role: Find unusual behaviour and precursors of severe drawdowns; challenge bullish candidates

machines.name: Ensemble & Horizon Selector
machines.role: Combine only independently validated machines and rank candidates per horizon without publishing a synthetic score
